#Explore the data
```{r}
#Tidyverse bibliotheek laden
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#Data inladen met read_csv() uit de readr package (maakt een tibble)
metadata <- read_csv("GSE80655_metadata.csv")
counts <- read_csv("GSE80655_counts.csv")
```

```{r}
# Eerste rijen bekijken met head()
head(metadata)
head(counts)
```

```{r}
# Afmetingen van de data controleren (aantal genen en samples)
nrow(counts)    # Aantal genen (features)
ncol(counts)    # Aantal RNA-seq samples + gennaam kolom
nrow(metadata)  # Aantal samples/observaties in metadata
```

```{r}
# Kolomtypes inspecteren met str()
str(metadata)
```
```{r}
# Categorische (nominale/ordinale) variabelen omzetten naar factor
# Dit kan direct op de kolommen of met mutate() en pipes (%>%):
metadata$diagnosis <- as.factor(metadata$diagnosis)
metadata$brain_region <- as.factor(metadata$brain_region)
metadata$sex <- as.factor(metadata$sex)
metadata$ethnicity <- as.factor(metadata$ethnicity)
```

```{r}
# Bekijk de aangepaste structuur en samenvattende statistieken
str(metadata)
summary(metadata)
```
# Missing values (NA)
```{r}
# Totaal aantal NA's per variabele in de metadata berekenen
colSums(is.na(metadata))
```
```{r}
# Tidyverse variant met summarise() om het aantal NA's overzichtelijk te bekijken
metadata %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```
```{r}
# Controleer of er eventueel NA's in de count-matrix zitten
sum(is.na(counts))
```
```{r}
# Optioneel: Als een sample een ontbrekende waarde heeft voor een belangrijke variabele,
# kun je deze filteren met drop_na() of filter(!is.na(...))
#metadata_clean <- metadata %>%
  #drop_na(pH, PMI, Age)
```

# Outliers
```{r}
# Samenvattende statistieken (min, kwantielen, mediaan, max) van continue variabelen
metadata %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  summary()
```
```{r}
# Visualize the distribution of brain pH (verifying minimal threshold pH >= 6.5)
metadata %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = brain_pH)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Brain pH Distribution",
       x = "Brain pH",
       y = "Sample Count")
```
```{r}
# Visualize Post-Mortem Interval (PMI) across diagnosis groups to detect outliers
metadata %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagnosis, y = PMI, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Post-Mortem Interval (PMI) by Diagnosis Group",
       x = "Diagnosis",
       y = "PMI (hours)")
```
# Quality control
```{r}
# Select numeric count columns only
counts_numeric <- counts %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))
# Calculate total sequencing depth per sample (Library Size)
library_sizes <- colSums(counts_numeric)
# View summary statistics of library sizes
summary(library_sizes)
```

```{r}
# Convert to a tibble for ggplot2 visualization
library_sizes_df <- tibble(
  Sample_ID = names(library_sizes),
  Total_Counts = library_sizes
)
```

```{r}
# Visualize the distribution of library sizes to identify samples with low read counts
library_sizes_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Total_Counts)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "darkseagreen", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Library Sizes",
       x = "Total Read Counts",
       y = "Sample Count")
```

```{r}
# Join library sizes with metadata using the 'description' column
library_sizes_df %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c("Sample_ID" = "description")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagnosis, y = Total_Counts, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Sequencing Depth by Diagnosis Group",
       x = "Diagnosis",
       y = "Total Read Counts")
```
#Preprocessing
```{r}
# Load the edgeR package (install via BiocManager::install("edgeR") if needed)
#BiocManager::install("edgeR")
install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("edgeR")
library(edgeR)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Convert counts dataframe to a matrix with gene IDs as rownames
gene_col <- colnames(counts)[1] # Identifies the first column (e.g., 'gene_id')

counts_matrix <- counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = gene_col) %>%
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
# Align metadata order with counts matrix column order
metadata_aligned <- metadata %>%
  arrange(match(description, colnames(counts_matrix)))
```

```{r}
# Verify exact match between count matrix columns and metadata sample IDs
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_matrix) == metadata_aligned$description))
```

```{r}
# Create DGEList object (edgeR standard container)
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts_matrix, group = metadata_aligned$diagnosis)
cat("Original count matrix dimensions (Genes x Samples):", dim(dge), "\n")
```
```{r}
# Filter low-expressed genes using Counts Per Million (CPM)
# Keep genes expressed at CPM >= 1 in at least 24 samples (size of smallest diagnosis group)
keep <- rowSums(cpm(dge) >= 1) >= 24
dge_filtered <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Filtered matrix dimensions (Genes x Samples):", dim(dge_filtered), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Calculate TMM Normalization Factors
dge_normalized <- calcNormFactors(dge_filtered, method = "TMM")
```
```{r}
# Inspect sample library sizes and normalization factors
head(dge_normalized$samples)
```

```{r}
# Extract normalized log2-CPM matrix for downstream analysis (PCA, ML, Limma)
log_cpm_matrix <- cpm(dge_normalized, log = TRUE, prior.count = 0.1)
```

#visualisation effect of normalization
```{r}
# Select first 10 samples for visual comparison
sample_subset <- colnames(log_cpm_matrix)[1:10]

# Prepare RAW counts for plotting (log10 transformed)
raw_log_df <- counts_matrix[keep, sample_subset] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Gene_ID, names_to = "Sample_ID", values_to = "Log_Count")

# Plot RAW count distributions
raw_log_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample_ID, y = log10(Log_Count + 1), fill = Sample_ID)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Raw Expression Distribution (Log10 Counts + 1)",
       x = "Sample ID",
       y = "log10(Count + 1)")

# Prepare NORMALIZED counts (log2-CPM) for plotting
norm_log_df <- log_cpm_matrix[, sample_subset] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Gene_ID, names_to = "Sample_ID", values_to = "LogCPM")

# Plot NORMALIZED log2-CPM distributions
norm_log_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample_ID, y = LogCPM, fill = Sample_ID)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Normalized Expression Distribution (TMM log2-CPM)",
       x = "Sample ID",
       y = "log2-CPM")
```
#Calculate the PCA
```{r}
# Transpose log2-CPM matrix (samples in rows, genes in columns) for prcomp()
pca_res <- prcomp(t(log_cpm_matrix))
```

```{r}
# Extract variance explained per PC (sdev^2) and visualize the top 20 components
pca_res$sdev^2 %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = NA) %>%
  rename(pca_var = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(pca_var / sum(pca_var) * 100, 1),
    component_number = rank(-percentage, ties.method = "random")
  ) %>%
  filter(component_number <= 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = component_number, y = percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot: Variance Explained per Principal Component",
       x = "Principal Component Number",
       y = "Percentage of Variance Explained (%)")
```

```{r}
# Extract component coordinates (x) and join with metadata via 'description'
pca_df <- pca_res$x %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = NA) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c("Sample_ID" = "description"))
```

```{r}
# PCA colored by Brain Region (Primary Biological Driver)
pca_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = brain_region)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot: Grouping by Brain Region",
       x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       color = "Brain Region")

```
```{r}
# B. PCA colored by Diagnosis Group
pca_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = diagnosis)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot: Grouping by Diagnosis",
       x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       color = "Diagnosis")
```
```{r}
# PCA colored by Sex (Checking demographic batch effect)
pca_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot: Inspection of Sex Effect",
       x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       color = "Sex")
```
```{r}
# D. PCA colored by Brain pH (Checking tissue quality covariate)
pca_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = brain_pH)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot: Inspection of Brain pH Gradient",
       x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       color = "Brain pH")
```
